description: Plan particulier d’intervention – barrage is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by La Rochelle. Le Plan Particulier d'Intervention est un dispositif qui vise à organiser les secours en cas d'accident sur des structures classées à risque pour la population alentour. Les barrages permettent de filtrer l’accès à la zone du sinistre. Coverage: La Rochelle. The publisher named on the listing is La Rochelle. Its keywords include circulation, barrage, risque, technologique, accident, industriel. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
